الوصف العام والميزات

A semantic search engine for Quran and Hadith translations using sentence embeddings, supporting multiple embedding models (SGPT variants, CocoSearch, Instructor Embedding). Covers the Clear Quran translation and Hadith collections (Bukhari and Muslim), with pre-computed embeddings for faster search via a simple Python API.
